description: Rothco’s Ragg Wool Gloves are made to keep your hands warm throughout the cold winter months. The work gloves are one size fits all, constructed of 85% wool and 15% nylon for extreme comfort. Rothco’s cold weather wool gloves are perfect for simple, everyday tasks and can fit a lining underneath for extra warmth. Rothco’s Ragg Wool Gloves are made in the U.S.A.
